title: Tariff Band Table: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Deferral Fee by Size of the Installment Deferred
content:
**Tariff.** How an Equipment & Vehicle Loans deferral fee is figured depends on the size of the installment deferred, taken as the interest and principal paid on the most recently billed installment, with the most recent interest payment and the most recent principal payment on that bill taken out again when the member's bank returned them: for an installment of 20000.00 or more the fee is 0.75 percent of the installment; for an installment of at least 5000.00 but less than 20000.00 the fee is the product's deferral fee plus 0.5 percent of the part of the installment above 5000.00; for a smaller installment the fee is the product's deferral fee.

## Size of the installment

The size is read from the loan's transaction history: the interest payments and the scheduled principal payments pointing to the most recently billed installment bill, less the most recent interest payment and the most recent principal payment on that bill where the member's bank returned them.

## Fee by band

| Size of the installment (USD) | Fee as figured |
|---|---|
| 20000.00 or more | 0.75 percent of the installment |
| at least 5000.00 but less than 20000.00 | the product's deferral fee plus 0.5 percent of the part above 5000.00 |
| less than 5000.00 | the product's deferral fee |

## Hypothetical figures (product deferral fee 150.00)

| Size | Fee as figured |
|---|---|
| 4999.99 | 150.00 |
| 5000.00 | 150.00 plus 0.5 percent of nothing, that is 150.00 |
| 12000.00 | 150.00 plus 0.5 percent of 7000.00, that is 185.00 |
| 19999.99 | 150.00 plus 0.5 percent of 14999.99, that is 224.99995 before rounding to cents |
| 20000.00 | 0.75 percent of 20000.00, that is 150.00 |
| 32000.00 | 0.75 percent of 32000.00, that is 240.00 |

Hypothetical: an installment of 9000.00 paid by interest and principal payments, the principal payment of 6500.00 later returned by the bank, has a size of 2500.00 and falls in the lowest band.
